test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a FALSE statement in the context of government budget?

options.text: There is no future obligation to return the amount in case of revenue receipts.
Profit earned through Indian Railways is a part of non-tax revenue.
Fees and fines collected is an example of capital receipt.
Recovery of a loan is a capital receipt.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fees and fines collected is an example of capital receipt**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fees and fines** are classified as **revenue receipts** because they are the government's income from providing services or enforcing law and order.
 
• They do not result in any liability nor lead to a decrease in government assets, distinguishing them from capital receipts.
 
• Capital receipts are mainly from **loans, disinvestment, or recovery of past loans**, which either increase liabilities or decrease assets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Revenue receipt:**

 
 
• Revenue receipts are those receipts that neither create any liability nor cause any reduction in the assets of the government
 
 
 
• **Capital Receipts:**
 
 
• Capital receipts are majorly involved in financing the expenditure that leads to the creation or liquidation of assets.
 
• Examples include proceeds from the sale of government shares, borrowing, or repayment of loans.
